## The intelligent   workplace requires   a smart, secure,   and an AI-powered solution

Microsoft Teams Rooms helps you deliver value across the entire meeting and workplace lifecycle. You can improve collaboration experiences by empowering your teams to Boost Productivity with Intelligent Spaces, Collaborate with Impact, and Optimize Workspaces, along with the broader business outcomes they enable.

### With the integration of Teams Phone, Teams Rooms, Teams Premium, and Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft powers your intelligent, hybrid and secure workplace.

Available features listed below must be enabled by the organization and may depend on Teams Premium and Copilot licenses, meeting type, tenant configuration, supported languages, rollout status, and region. ## Deter information leaks, safeguard meetings, and protect against unwanted calls

Secure Information

Reduce Vishing Attacks

AI-powered Management

## Secure  information

Easily apply the right sensitivity labels and limit who can record

Enable customized watermarking for content and attendee video

Automatically apply policies with meeting templates

Apply end-to-end encryption (E2EE) for calls and meetings

![Secure Information](https://avisplstorage.blob.core.windows.net/avispl/secureinforation.gif)
